_readme: Baseline for the LOCAL CodeQL SARIF gate (scripts/codeql-gate.mjs, run by security.yml).
GitHub pulled code-scanning upload for free-plan private repos (2026-07-21), so Security-tab
dismissals no longer apply — this file replaces them. An entry means: a HUMAN reviewed the
finding and accepted it as a false positive. The gate still fails on ANY finding not listed
here. Match is ruleId + file (not line — lines drift). Remove entries when the code they
cover is rewritten; the gate warns about entries that no longer match anything.

accepted.reason: False positive: sanitizer runs all replacements inside a do..while fixpoint loop (see comment at the loop, added in the CodeQL 28->0 sweep 2026-07-17); CodeQL's checker does not model fixpoint convergence. Dismissed on the Security tab while upload still worked; re-accepted by Cuong 2026-07-22 (PR #432).
False positive: same fixpoint-loop pattern in stripHtml() (strip + entity-decode to convergence). Dismissed on the Security tab while upload still worked; re-accepted by Cuong 2026-07-22 (PR #432).
